title.narrative: Scale up TB and HIV interventions in Tanzania - Tanzania (United Republic) (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Tanzania (United Republic), Tuberculosis, Ministry of Finance of the United Republic of Tanzania (MoF)This program has the following goals: To reduce the incidence by 25% and mortality by 50% of TB and Leprosy by 2020. The objectives of this program are: Objective 1: Increase TB case detection by 30% by 2020 from 2013 levels.. Objective 2: Increase MDR TB cases detected and enrolled for treatment from 17% of the estimated total cases among those notified to 84% by 2020. Objective 3: Expand TB/HIV collaborative to ensure 100% of all TB patients are tested for HIV by 2017.
